item.title: CVE-2026-107785 · 6.3 MEDIUM 🌩️ — Crux Agent silently fails SKA preshared key rotation when SHA-512 peering is negotiated
item.description: Crux Agent from 1.9.0 before 2.0.3 uses the full SKA bilocation key as the WireGuard preshared key. When a peering session negotiates use of SHA-512, the key produced is 64 bytes instead of the 32 bytes WireGuard requires. The agent does not validate…
